cases.name: empty-line
cases.provokes: A bare terminator with no document. pyk rpc.py:379-380 treats it as fatal; so does TcpTransport, which additionally poisons the connection.

cases.name: blank-then-response
cases.provokes: A whitespace-only line ahead of a valid one. Still fatal: the emptiness check is on the line after a trailing-\r strip, mirroring pyk's rstrip, so whitespace does not smuggle a line past it.

cases.name: unterminated
cases.provokes: A document with no terminator, followed by EOF. Never becomes a line; the pending request settles on the close, not on a parse failure.

cases.name: two-lines-one-write
cases.provokes: Two responses to one request. The first is delivered; the second has no request to belong to on a single-flight connection, and poisons the transport.

cases.name: not-json
cases.provokes: A well-framed line that is not a JSON document — what a backend writing a crash message to its socket would produce. The transport delivers it (framing is its only concern); decodeResponse is what rejects it.

cases.name: wrong-id
cases.provokes: A well-formed response echoing an id that was never sent. pyk asserts (rpc.py:389); KoreClient throws ResponseIdMismatchError.
